{"settings":"{
  "breadcrumbs.showArrays": false,
  "breadcrumbs.showBooleans": false,
  "breadcrumbs.showClasses": false,
  "breadcrumbs.showConstants": false,
  "breadcrumbs.showFunctions": false,
  "breadcrumbs.showNull": false,
  "breadcrumbs.showNumbers": false,
  "breadcrumbs.showObjects": false,
  "breadcrumbs.showOperators": false,
  "breadcrumbs.showProperties": false,
  "breadcrumbs.showStrings": false,
  "breadcrumbs.showStructs": false,
  "breadcrumbs.showTypeParameters": false,
  "breadcrumbs.showVariables": false,
  "breadcrumbs.symbolPath": "off",
  "cSpell.userWords": [
    "clonedeep",
    "fullwidth",
    "ikigailabs",
    "Linebreaks",
    "rgba",
    "Structs"
  ],
  "color-highlight.enable": false,
  "comment-divider.languagesMap": {
    "javascriptreact": ["//*"],
    "typescript": ["//"],
    "typescriptreact": ["//*"]
  },
  "comment-divider.length": 80,
  "comment-divider.lineFiller": "—",
  "comment-divider.mainHeaderAlign": "left",
  "comment-divider.mainHeaderFiller": "─",
  "comment-divider.shouldLengthIncludeIndent": true,
  "comment-divider.subheaderAlign": "left",
  "comment-divider.subheaderFiller": "—",
  "css.lint.unknownAtRules": "ignore",
  "diffEditor.hideUnchangedRegions.enabled": true,
  "diffEditor.ignoreTrimWhitespace": false,
  "diffEditor.renderSideBySide": true,
  "editor.accessibilitySupport": "off",
  "editor.cursorWidth": 2,
  "editor.defaultFormatter": "esbenp.prettier-vscode",
  "editor.dropIntoEditor.enabled": false,
  "editor.fastScrollSensitivity": 3,
  "editor.fontFamily": "SF Mono",
  "editor.fontLigatures": true,
  "editor.fontWeight": "normal",
  "editor.formatOnSave": true,
  "editor.gotoLocation.multipleDefinitions": "goto",
  "editor.guides.bracketPairs": "active",
  "editor.hideCursorInOverviewRuler": true,
  "editor.inlineSuggest.enabled": true,
  "editor.insertSpaces": false,
  "editor.minimap.renderCharacters": false,
  "editor.minimap.showSlider": "always",
  "editor.mouseWheelScrollSensitivity": 1.5,
  "editor.padding.bottom": 100,
  "editor.renderWhitespace": "none",
  "editor.rulers": [80],
  "editor.scrollBeyondLastLine": false,
  "editor.scrollbar.horizontal": "hidden",
  "editor.scrollbar.verticalScrollbarSize": 0,
  "editor.smartSelect.selectSubwords": false,
  "editor.smoothScrolling": true,
  "editor.stickyScroll.enabled": false,
  "editor.suggestSelection": "first",
  "editor.unicodeHighlight.nonBasicASCII": false,
  "errorLens.fontSize": "12",
  "errorLens.fontStyleItalic": true,
  "errorLens.onSave": true,
  "errorLens.removeLinebreaks": false,
  "errorLens.scrollbarHackEnabled": true,
  "eslint.run": "onSave",
  "explorer.confirmDelete": false,
  "explorer.confirmDragAndDrop": false,
  "explorer.confirmPasteNative": false,
  "files.autoSave": "onFocusChange",
  "files.autoSaveDelay": 1000,
  "files.exclude": {
    "(Untracked)": true,
    "Keyboard Shortcuts": true,
    "Working Tree": true
  },
  "files.trimFinalNewlines": true,
  "files.trimTrailingWhitespace": true,
  "git.autofetch": true,
  "git.confirmSync": false,
  "git.enableSmartCommit": true,
  "git.ignoreMissingGitWarning": true,
  "git.mergeEditor": true,
  "git.openRepositoryInParentFolders": "never",
  "git.postCommitCommand": "push",
  "github.copilot.enable": {
    "*": true,
    "javascript": true,
    "javascriptreact": true,
    "jsonc": false,
    "markdown": false,
    "plaintext": false,
    "yaml": false
  },
  "html.format.indentInnerHtml": true,
  "javascript.format.insertSpaceAfterConstructor": true,
  "javascript.format.semicolons": "insert",
  "javascript.preferences.quoteStyle": "single",
  "javascript.updateImportsOnFileMove.enabled": "always",
  "multiCommand.commands": [
    {
      "command": "multiCommand.openExplorer",
      "sequence": ["workbench.view.explorer", "workbench.action.closePanel"]
    },
    {
      "command": "multiCommand.closeSidebar",
      "sequence": ["workbench.action.closeSidebar"]
    },
    {
      "command": "multiCommand.openSettingsInNewWorkspace",
      "sequence": ["workbench.action.duplicateWorkspaceInNewWindow"]
    }
  ],
  "prettier.jsxSingleQuote": true,
  "prettier.singleQuote": true,
  "prettier.withNodeModules": true,
  "remote.extensionKind": {
    "pub.name": ["ui"]
  },
  "search.decorations.badges": false,
  "security.promptForLocalFileProtocolHandling": false,
  "security.workspace.trust.enabled": false,
  "security.workspace.trust.startupPrompt": "always",
  "security.workspace.trust.untrustedFiles": "open",
  "terminal.explorerKind": "external",
  "terminal.integrated.defaultProfile.osx": "zsh",
  "terminal.integrated.enableImages": true,
  "terminal.integrated.smoothScrolling": true,
  "typescript.format.insertSpaceAfterFunctionKeywordForAnonymousFunctions": false,
  "typescript.preferences.quoteStyle": "single",
  "typescript.updateImportsOnFileMove.enabled": "always",
  "window.closeWhenEmpty": false,
  "window.commandCenter": false,
  "window.confirmSaveUntitledWorkspace": false,
  "window.newWindowDimensions": "inherit",
  "window.title": "${rootName}",
  "workbench.editor.closeOnFileDelete": true,
  "workbench.editor.empty.hint": "hidden",
  "workbench.editor.limit.enabled": true,
  "workbench.editor.limit.perEditorGroup": true,
  "workbench.editor.limit.value": 1,
  "workbench.editor.showTabs": "single",
  "workbench.iconTheme": "eq-material-theme-icons-light",
  "workbench.layoutControl.enabled": false,
  "workbench.list.smoothScrolling": true,
  "workbench.localHistory.enabled": false,
  "workbench.preferredDarkColorTheme": "Default Dark+",
  "workbench.preferredHighContrastColorTheme": "Default Dark+",
  "workbench.preferredHighContrastLightColorTheme": "Default Dark+",
  "workbench.preferredLightColorTheme": "Default Dark+",
  "workbench.startupEditor": "none",
  "workbench.tree.enableStickyScroll": false,
  "workbench.tree.renderIndentGuides": "none",
  "errorLens.enabledDiagnosticLevels": ["error", "warning"],
  "workbench.tree.indent": 20,
  "workbench.activityBar.location": "hidden",
  "workbench.editor.enablePreview": false,
  "workbench.colorTheme": "Xcode Default (Dark)",
  "editor.scrollbar.vertical": "hidden",
  "window.zoomLevel": 1,
  "explorer.autoReveal": true,
  "editor.tabSize": 2,
  "explorer.compactFolders": false
}"}
